newsitem.title: INDIA: Rockwell to invest $20-30 mln in India.
newsitem.headline: Rockwell to invest $20-30 mln in India.

text.p: Rockwell International Corp plans to invest between $20 million and $30 million in its Indian operations in the next two years, president Don Davis said on Tuesday.

Davis told reporters in the southern city of Bangalore that the U.S. firm aimed to increase annual revenues from its Indian operations to $89 million this year from $70 million. He did not specify the exact periods.
"We are committed to India for the long term," he said.
The Rockwell executive said the company planned to start a software development centre in India by the end of 1997.

"Working with the very talented Indian workforce, we want to continue to build our research and manufacturing presence within India, sharing our technology and manufacturing expertise to develop and build new products and systems for both markets in India and for export," he said.
Davis on Tuesday visited one of the two Rockwell plants in India, Autarky Auto Products.
